priority_assessment: Both planned MOSS steps landed. Run 8f3056687837 verified recipe a7f5c5513e68, and the corrected timing check recorded a 1.322 s median guided step against ComfyUI's 1.113 s average between progress events. This gives us a sampling measurement. Whole-workflow parity still needs a comparable section run.

Master at 1a830d10c has no remaining implementation rows. I would take the proposed measure-reached/do next. The last measurement spent 7 h 35 min in the longer tests and stopped before measuring cells. Reusing still-valid passes while rerunning failed, missing or affected tests addresses that cost. findings.input: Request a MOSS training proof with its valid model and pictures when runrecord.ExecutableCodeCommit cannot identify the executable's revision. A binary marked as built from modified source is one example.
findings.expected: For an explicit proof, use the existing revision check during admission, before preflight reports ready or training uses the GPU. A proof that cannot produce its required verification should return the revision error. Keep ordinary exploratory training available and retain the final check on the evidence.
findings.actual: The recovery recorded in c0f0b56d3 trained with an uncommitted test in the checkout, produced no verification and repeated training on a clean checkout. Source explains the late verdict. Observer.Admit calls Ready before checking the revision. After training, Observer.Verify prints the revision error and returns nil. The direct proof can therefore exit successfully without its verification. An acquiring validator detects the missing handoff only after the trainer exits.

SQA-522.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 5b8dbb6fc: valid, observed by the lead at c0f0b56d3 (a -proof run from a checkout holding the next row's test trained on the card, then printed that it verified nothing and exited 0). Filed as proof-revision/do: a run given -proof asks for its code revision right after its flags are parsed, before admission says it is ready or the card is used. Implemented 2026-11-28 by proof-revision/do, the landing that carries this answer: a -proof run the validator awaits (its preflight, OVERGO_PREFLIGHT, or its acquisition, OVERGO_TRAIN_VERIFICATION) asks for its code revision once its flags are read and is refused with that reason before admission says it is ready or the card is used; a -proof run by hand is told before it starts and trains as before, since the gate's own candidate checkout is a modified tree its tests run proofs in (TestAProofThatCannotVerifyIsRefusedFirst), for the review's recheck.
